title: PVL: Feeling the pressure, Savi Davison and PLDT end early slump

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — With a lot of pressure on contender team PLDT, Savi Davison rediscovered her scoring touch to restore order and barge into the win column in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Davison unleashed 28 points as PLDT outlasted Capital1, 21-25, 25-21, 25-21, 25-21, on Saturday at Filoil EcoOil Centre. “I honestly… It’s hard. I’m not gonna lie but I feel like Kath (Arado) also recognizes the position that I’m in. Like we… She’s a really big part of our defense and I feel like I carry the offensive side but we do have a lot of pressure on […]...
